cards.sig: the station has got / gotten a lot nicer. also fine: has become a lot nicer the station · nice they renovated it last year a place near you that has got / gotten a lot nicer — or a lot worse. what happened?

tvs are a lot cheaper than they used to be. also fine: tvs have got / gotten a lot cheaper. tvs · cheap you pay much less now than twenty years ago two things that are a lot cheaper — or a lot more expensive — than they used to be. which one do you notice most?
the summers are getting hotter and hotter. the summers · hot every year it’s worse two things that are getting better and better — or worse and worse — where you live. which one matters most to you?

my favourite restaurant isn’t as good as it used to be. also fine: … isn’t as good as it was. my favourite restaurant · good it was better ten years ago a café, a shop or a tv show that isn’t as good as it used to be. what’s changed?

the old town has become a lot more touristy. also fine: … is a lot more touristy than it used to be. the old town · touristy souvenir shops everywhere now a place that has become a lot more touristy — or one that hasn’t changed at all. why do you think that is?
my street is getting noisier and noisier. my street · noisy a new bar opens every month what’s getting more and more popular where you live? who’s happy about it, and who isn’t?
